model_annotation: This line diagram illustrates the relationship between trajectory length and the variable gamma (γ). model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the relationship between trajectory length and the variable gamma, comparing three categories: Unsuccessful, All, and Successful. The x-axis is labeled as gamma, with a linear scale ranging from 0.85 to 1.00, and tick labels at regular intervals of 0.02. The y-axis is labeled as trajectory length, with a linear scale ranging from 10 to 22, and tick labels at regular intervals of 2. The plot features three lines: a red dashed line representing Unsuccessful, a blue dashed line representing All, and a green dashed line representing Successful. The red line starts approximately at (0.85, 17.5) and ends at (1.00, 21.5), with a generally increasing trend, showing a slight acceleration in increase around gamma 0.98. The blue line starts approximately at (0.85, 16) and ends at (1.00, 19.5), also showing a generally increasing trend. The green line starts approximately at (0.85, 10.5) and ends at (1.00, 14.5), displaying a generally increasing trend as well, with a more pronounced increase near gamma 0.98.
